BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

2. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.

   B. Keyboard

   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

16. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
